t: The Titan 18V cordless lawnmower is a brushless electric mower designed for regular maintenance of small to medium lawns up to 250m². Supplied with a 5.0Ah Li-ion TXP battery and charger, it delivers consistent cutting performance with reduced vibration. The 34cm steel blade, six cutting heights from 25–75mm and mulching facility support controlled grass management. Close-edge mowing improves results along borders, while the 35L grass bag with fill indicator helps minimise interruptions. A practical cordless lawnmower for trade and domestic grounds work.
